messages:
Alex M.: Hey -- hitting a weird onboarding snag. Followed the node sample, set REDWOOD_API_KEY in my env, but my first curl returns 401. After I rotated the key it started returning 403 with 'workspace billing_required'.
Priya K.: ugh. can you paste the curl and headers (no keys) + the exact body?
Alex M.: sure:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" 
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}'
```
Got 401 initially, then tried creating a new workspace service key and now get: 
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"workspace requires billing account"}
Alex M.: I thought billing gating kicks in only after free credits? this is a fresh org with email invite.
infra-bot: FYI: New workspace created (id ws_01G7...) by alex@company.com. Billing status: NONE.
Sarah L.: if infra-bot says billing NONE then 403 makes sense. New orgs should be able to use promotional credits, but that depends on the workspace tier. Did you sign up via self-serve or invite?
Alex M.: invited by our SSO admin. There was a banner about 'accept workspace invite' but I clicked. No credit card was added.
Jess (support): Hi Alex — support here. We recently had a regression where invited workspaces were marked as 'requires_billing' until a completion step in the console. I can flip the flag for you. Can you share workspace id via DM?
Tomas R.: tagging dx doc owners: this flow is confusing. We should show a clearer console CTA after invite + better error message from the API: 'workspace requires billing' is ambiguous. Suggest we return an actionable code like billing_required:setup_console_link.
Priya K.: Also noticed SDKs surface 401 for expired keys but then the same code path gives 403 for billing. The client retries on 401 which made Alex rotate key unnecessarily. We should avoid auto-rotate on 401 if 403 is possible next.
Alex M.: thanks Jess — flip worked, I retried and got 200 :) First successful call logged.
Jess (support): Great. Filing internal ticket RDW-4521 for: 1) console onboarding CTA after invite, 2) clearer API error payload, 3) SDK retry policy tweak.
Sarah L.: can we also add a small note in the quickstart: 'If you were invited, confirm billing/onboarding link in console before first call' — saves a lot of support back-and-forth.
Tomas R.: I'll draft the SDK PR to change retry-on-401 behavior and add telemetry to detect the '401->403 rotate' pattern.
Alex M.: thanks everyone. leaving notes in our onboarding doc to avoid this. :thumbsup:
Jess (support): closing the loop — Alex, if anything else pops up ping #devex and we'll prioritize the doc/change.
